Basis ... 1 Project Planner (f/m/d) As a Project Planner within our Gas Services division, you will be responsible within the project team and at the project construction site for the preparation and controlling of the integrated project time schedule in accordance with the relevant process procedure for complex and high risk turnkey projects or within a consortium.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Develop and optimize the overall project time schedule for complex turnkey or consortium projects, which typically involve around 3000 to 5000 activities, using a reference time schedule as a foundation for planning.
 * Adapt and refine the time schedule to meet specific project requirements by employing proven methods that ensure the successful completion of the project within the designated timeframe.
 * Coordinate the time schedule with the project team and consortium partners to facilitate the timely release of the Project Manager (PM), ensuring that all stakeholders are aligned and informed.
 * Present the Siemens Energy Time Management concept convincingly to customers, consortium partners, and suppliers, with the goal of applying our standards while minimizing the need for adjustments.
 * Provide support for Contract Management (CM) and Proposal Planning by integrating time management considerations into the overall project strategy and documentation.
 * Continuously monitor and follow up on the time schedule, taking into account boundary conditions and collaborating with different project managers, consortium partners, and site staff to ensure adherence to timelines.
 * Conduct regular checks to control progress and ensure that target dates are met across various disciplines, including those involving consortium partners and on-site personnel.
 * Collect and analyze relevant schedule data to evaluate the impact on project progress, including factors such as manhours, quantities, and contractual milestones, and communicate findings to the Project Manager.
 * Prepare internal reports related to the time schedule, such as MTA, S-curves, EVM, variance reports, and critical path reports, to provide insights into project performance and areas for improvement.
 * Identify and document all claim-relevant delays and corresponding events in a delay register, ensuring that this information is archived for future analysis and claim preparation, including activities related to consortium partners.

What You Bring

 * Bachelor's degree with focus project management and process management, or a related discipline.
 * Experience in the execution of turnkey and consortium projects, work at construction sites /regional unit execution
 * Advanced proficiency in Primavera software
 * Advanced understanding in regards of time management, process management and associated PM knowledge areas (interface management, document management, contract management, etc.)
 * Excellent communication skills in English and German with the ability to present complex planning data clearly to diverse stakeholders.
 * Strong analytical mindset with well developed problem solving capabilities.
 * Willingness to work on projects abroad
 * Driving license

Rewards/Benefits

 * The opportunity to engage in an exciting environment on meaningful projects
 * Opportunities for career growth within a supportive workplace culture
 * International environment, along with a pension fund
 * Enjoy flexible working hours and the option to work from home
 * Access to a canteen or meal allowances

And more!

jobs.description:
1 Senior Research Engineer - Cross-Platform Microfabrication Processes (all genders) As part of the European Chips Act, Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) is driving innovation in quantum and semiconductor technologies through its Pilot Lines. 

Join our interdisciplinary teams at the interface of technology and fabrication and enjoy Villach's exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Austrian Alps. Be part of something bigger. Be part of Silicon Austria Labs.

The role is part of the new Pilot Line Operations (PLO) Team within the Microsystem Division. PLO is a multidisciplinary engineering team bridging research and pilot-line operations, combining microfabrication expertise, process integration, documentation and coordination between Research Units and the SAL cleanroom infrastructure.

Your future tasks include:
 * Hands-on execution of microfabrication processes across lithography, deposition, etching, cleaning, metrology and other relevant process modules.
 * Develop, integrate, troubleshoot and optimize complex microfabrication process flows, including cross-tool and cross-module interactions.
 * Execute and lead fabrication runs, analyze results and identify process integration issues, deviations and root causes: pilot-line runs, MPWs, technology demonstrators and external fabrication activities.
 * Assessing Technology and pilot-line maturity.
 * Work directly with scientists to translate new research concepts into fabricable process flows and experimental process runs.
 * Work closely with cleanroom tool owners and engineers to ensure compatibility with tool capabilities, cleanroom constraints and operational requirements.
 * Define and maintain process documentation, flow diagrams, process specifications, run sheets, recipes, track of changes and lessons learned.
 * Help establish standardized ways of working for process development, integration, documentation, qualification and scale-up.
 * Platform Specialization: Focusing primarily on one of the key Microsystems technology platforms (Quantum Technologies, Photonics, PiezoMEMS, Magnetic Microsystems) but operating across multiple projects.

Your profile:
 * MSc/PhD in microelectronics, microsystems, semiconductors, physics or a related field.
 * 5+ years of hands-on experience in semiconductor, MEMS, photonics or microfabrication technology, preferably in a cleanroom industrial environment.
 * Demonstrated expertise in fabrication process development and integration, with the ability to execute and troubleshoot processes. 
 * Broad understanding of multiple microfabrication modules and their interactions, rather than expertise limited to a single process step. 
 * Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to move between hands-on cleanroom work, process engineering, documentation and coordination. 
 * Strong organizational and documentation skills for technical reporting and professional documentation. 
 * Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively while supporting multiple stakeholders.
 * Excellent teamwork, communication, reporting, and organizational skills. 
 * Excellent oral and written communication skills in English (German is a plus)

Important Facts about SAL:
 * Diverse research activities with many technical challenges.
 * State-of-the-art laboratory facilities and equipment.
 * Location in the heart of Europe in Austria - relocation support for non-European nationalities.
 * Internal and external training opportunities for career development.
 * Family & children friendly - actively shaping the compatibility of family and career.
 * "Vital4SAL" to promote a healthy workplace (e.g. SAL coaching pool, trainings on mental health, physical activities, healthy snacks, 24/7 accident insurance)

Our pioneer spirit and passion for the world of the iron and steel industry has made us to recognized pioneers in our sector.

7.800 employees worldwide, including 1.700 at the Linz site, drive our technologies and projects forward. The Global Controlling department (FS GC R) in Linz is seeking a qualified Controller to support global financial steering and contribute to a broad range of controlling activities for our international organization.  * Interest in IT tools

In addition to your interest in this role - which offers many exciting insights - you will convince us on a personal level with your friendly demeanor, a high degree of initiative, commitment and strong communication skills in an intercultural environment.
